summary.en: The camera rises over the whole desk; the name settles under the row, its line, the address types; a rule under the name and the pencil’s route through every ringed region; the last ring round the address.
summary.zh: 镜头升起俯瞰整张桌面；名字落在一排截图下方，跟着一行说明，网址逐字打出；名字下画一道线，铅笔路线连起所有圈过的区域；最后一圈圈住网址。

fits: The close of an exhibit film.
notFor: A film without real prints; an end card on a gradient.

intent.en: End on the whole body of evidence at once, with the name under it.
intent.zh: 在全部证据同时入画时收尾，名字压在下面。

content.en: The desk’s prints; the name (≤ 16 chars / 8 字), a line (≤ 7 words / 18 字), the address; the ringed regions in order; an optional mark.
content.zh: 桌上的截图；名字（≤ 16 字符 / 8 字）、一行（≤ 7 词 / 18 字）、网址；按顺序圈过的区域；可选标志。

notFor.zh: 没有真实截图的片子；渐变底的尾卡。

en: Hold the address at least 3 s.

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
